snippet.title: The Conjuring: Unspoken | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new Netflix game, is coming October 13.

Set in a decaying English pub where a family is haunted by an ancient evil, use your phone as a paranormal investigation tool and make life-or-death choices that shape your story.

Developed by Supermassive Games.

Play games instantly on your TV* and computer (Netflix.com), all included in your Netflix membership with no ads or extra fees. Whether you’re on the couch or at your desk, your next adventure is just a click away.

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
